svg.text: Prove restore without replacing the original
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Build the same supported IIS/PHP/database baseline on an isolated copy, not on DC01 or over
your only working APP01. Keep outgoing mail disabled to avoid duplicate notifications.
Restore the site files and import the SQL dump using the MariaDB client SOURCE command.
Recreate the dedicated database account and adjust the protected configuration to this recovery
Use an isolated client’s hosts entry for helpdesk.lab.example.test pointing only to the recovery
IP; do not change shared DNS. Verify login, the known ticket and its attachment. Remove that
temporary hosts entry afterward. Record recovery time, then retire or isolate the restored
Check: A known ticket and attachment are readable on the isolated restored application.
